hook: What if 1 grid from 1502 became the model for colonial towns?

sections.voiceover: What if 1 grid from 1502 became the model for colonial towns?
b_roll: Historical colonial urban grid map of Santo Domingo along the Ozama River

sections.voiceover: Why did Ovando build a grid across the river?
b_roll: Map showing the Ozama River with original 1498 settlement on east bank and 1502 west bank transfer

sections.voiceover: However, in 1500, Francisco de Bobadilla presided over a population of just 300 people.
b_roll: Historical portrait graphic of Francisco de Bobadilla with 1500 timeline marker

sections.voiceover: Ovando laid out an administrative center using an orthogonal grid pattern. That layout organized colonial institutions on the west bank. The 1502 grid became a model for town planners across the New World.
b_roll: Orthogonal grid layout diagram showing colonial town spatial center and street lines

sections.voiceover: In 1502, Governor Nicolás de Ovando transferred Santo Domingo to the Ozama River's west bank.
b_roll: Map of colonial city grid layout in Santo Domingo
